title: Oppenheimer created the classification covering UFOs
summary: David Grusch tells of Oppenheimer created the classification covering UFOs, about 1940s-1950s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: because Oppenheimer was the one who created the classification that included the UFO stuff.
Dave grush said that uh Oppenheimer was part of setting up the original UFO secrecy protocols with the atomic energy commission
tellings.difference: Tells it as setting up secrecy protocols with the Atomic Energy Commission, where the story's telling has Oppenheimer creating the classification.
tellings.link_reason: Both credit Grusch with the claim that Oppenheimer set up the secrecy and classification that covered UFOs.
